migration_contract.marker_policy: create-only, mode 0600, presence-only; do not read or overwrite an existing marker
migration_contract.later_fast_choice: kept as a reported conflict once the marker exists
migration_contract.dry_run: no home/config/backup/marker or native client mutation
migration_contract.native_precheck: old value and expected raw snapshot hash must match before a native expected-version write
migration_contract.native_readback: write version equals native layer version; changed and unowned keys verified; validate and hash one full disk snapshot
migration_contract.rollback: restore only against the last verified write hash, preserving intervening edits; retain original backup

limits: Source metadata, synthetic native RPC replies and local integrity checks are not real native writer or provider acceptance.
Config completion and marker creation are separate writes; crash recovery between them is not atomic.
Failed fresh marker creation leaves a failed adoption with default config. Retry at default completes it; a /fast choice before retry cannot be distinguished from unmarked legacy fast.
Canonical native versions cannot attribute formatting-only edits before disk snapshot capture to another writer.
Additional owned migration rules require a declared partial-marker recovery policy.
No host apply, credential handling, merge or readiness change performed by this lane.
